causal_parent.finding: The current Pair-VQ assignment chart, not code-identity history transport, destroys the dense Muon polar direction at both frozen late probes.

hypothesis.claim: A full-support low-bit ambient momentum state can retain the dense Muon polar field while the model weight remains Pair-VQ compact.
hypothesis.mechanism: Decode the previous compact momentum, apply the exact causal momentum recurrence with the current dense gradient, quantize the new momentum blockwise, and carry the decoded state into the next update. A second low-bit residual tier is forward-visible and temporally persistent, so it refines the state without a dense error buffer.
non_claims: This does not demonstrate language-model loss closure.
This does not authorize a larger model or longer horizon.

frozen_protocol.training_path: The matched dense parent is the only path that updates model parameters. Every compact arm is nonintervening.

quantization.ternary2: Per 64-value block, codes are {-1,0,+1}; active entries satisfy |x| >= 0.5*RMS and the least-squares active mean-absolute magnitude is rounded to FP16.
quantization.symmetric_int4: Per 64-value block, one FP16 scale is absmax/7 and codes are round(x/scale) clipped to [-7,7].
quantization.residual_tier: Quantize target minus decoded primary with its own codes and FP16 block scale; decoded primary plus decoded residual is the forward-visible state used now and carried to the next recurrence.
quantization.padding: Zero-pad only the last block for coding and exclude padding from all metrics and storage counts.

state_recurrence.compact: U_next = momentum * decode(compact_previous) + gradient; compact_next = encode(U_next)
state_recurrence.polar_map: Use the exact production Newton-Schulz Muon update and the owning dense optimizer group's ns_steps.

measurements: momentum-state energy recovery, relative error, and cosine
combined pre-polar request recovery, relative error, and cosine
post-polar Muon update recovery, relative error, and cosine
actual simulated bytes and theoretical packed persistent bytes

decision_gate.selection: Among passing candidates, choose minimum theoretical packed bytes, then maximum minimum late all-polar cosine. Controls that fail remain diagnostic only.
decision_gate.if_pass: Authorize theory and an implementation-quality packed-code optimizer-state prototype with unit tests and an exact-config >=20% MFU gate. Do not yet authorize an LM endpoint.
decision_gate.if_fail: Reject this codec family and derive a different full-support compact tangent representation before any LM endpoint.
